description: This file is a React component named EntityTable that displays and manages a list of entities grouped by type, with inline editing and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: EntityTable({ entities, onChange })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grouped table of entities with inline edit/delete capabilities.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing for a specific entity field.

methods.name: commitEdit
methods.description: Commits the current inline edit for an entity and updates the parent component.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the inline editing process for an entity.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Removes an entity from the list.

methods.name: renderGroup
methods.description: Renders a group of entities of a specific type.
